_comment: Phase 0 discovery output — the map the monday build step reads. Column IDs/types confirmed against the live boards on the discovery date. Regenerate/verify if board structure changes.

catalog_doc.title: Field Technician AI — Directory Skills Catalog
catalog_doc._comment: Decision: index + context. Drives what we parse (the two boards below) AND is included as an orienting section in the corpus.

boards.name: RP Document Library
boards._comment: Full document text is posted to each item's UPDATES thread by monday's existing 'Extract File Data' workflow. Read columns + updates. Do NOT open/parse the attached files. expects_full_text=true so items missing extracted text get flagged.

skip_columns.title: File
skip_columns.reason: attachment — do not open; text is in updates

skip_columns.title: Owners List of Needed Improvements/Changes
skip_columns.reason: owner scratchpad — catalog marks as non-authoritative

skip_columns.title: Supersedes
skip_columns.reason: revision link — optional, adds little text

status_filter._comment: Default to current guidance only. Old Revision/Obsolete live in the Archive group and would bloat the corpus with stale content.

boards._exclude_groups_comment: Carve out the Archive section entirely — stale/superseded records the field bot must not surface, regardless of item status. Matched by group title, case-insensitive.

boards.name: Master Parts List
boards._comment: Clean structured data — no file attachments. WLAK group MAY carry deeper detail in subitems/description per the catalog, but sampled WLAK items had empty subitems; verify before relying on it.

skip_columns.title: Subitems
skip_columns.reason: handled via subitems fetch, not as a column value

status_filter._comment: Keep everything else; label each part's status so the model can flag On Hold / Phasing Out / Initial Field Trials appropriately.

boards._exclude_groups_comment: No Archive group exists on this board today, but exclude it defensively so a future Archive section is never surfaced. Matched by group title, case-insensitive.

groups.title: WLAK Assemblies
groups.note: Group title carries a live cross-reference: 'ADJ NUT 14435 = 60409; Legacy Adj Nut is now 60536' — capture the group title text into the corpus.

out_of_scope_boards._comment: The catalog Doc also documents these two boards, but they are NOT part of this project and carry sensitivity constraints (do not surface individual records / customer / pricing data). Listed here only so a future maintainer knows they exist and why they were excluded.

First Alert Tracker.reason: failure-case data; pattern-summary only, not record lookup
